## Purpose

Describe the issue, scope, and intended result.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the change and pass locally.
- [ ] Normative and explanatory documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Imported or generated artifacts have complete provenance and reuse records.
- [ ] No confidential, proprietary, personal, credential, or patent-sensitive material is included.
- [ ] Claims do not exceed the behavior actually tested.
- [ ] Every commit has a valid DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [ ] Material generated with assistance has received accountable human review.
